itens.titulo: Apple is set to take back the market-cap crown from Nvidia. Upcoming earnings may push it over the top
itens.descricao: Apple is set to take back the market-cap crown from Nvidia. Upcoming earnings may push it over the top CNBC
trechos: Apple on Friday was trading at a market value of $5.05 trillion, compared to $5.10 trillion for Nvidia.
Apple shares are having a great October — up 4% — as concerns about the AI financing environment drag Nvidia down 7% for the month.
Apple is currently one of the top five holdings in our Essential 40 ETF .
The iPhone Duo is a premium product, starting at $1,999 and climbing above $3,000 for the highest-storage model.

Revenue expectations are around $113 billion, following Apple's earlier guidance for 9% to 11% year-over-year growth.
Services generated about $109 billion in revenue in fiscal 2025, accounting for only about a quarter of Apple's business.
Yet it carries gross margins of approximately 75%, compared with roughly 37% for hardware.

itens.descricao: Alphabet Stocks Face Wednesday Earnings Test After 82% Cloud Revenue Growth Yahoo Finance
trechos: Alphabet, the search, advertising and cloud giant (NASDAQ:GOOGL), traded at $323.57, down approximately 0.21%, at about 10:00 a.m.
GuruFocus has detected 3 Warning Sign with CRWD.
Alphabet's earnings release showed revenue of $24.8 billion, up 82%, alongside $8.8 billion in operating income and a 35.6% operating margin.
Investors need to watch whether TPU hardware sales add meaningful revenue while Cloud protects its margins, with $5.8 billion in shared AI-research costs also in focus.
The valuation graphic puts the shares 24.7% above the $259.48 GF Value estimate, suggesting the price already carries substantial expectations.

itens.titulo: Tempo real: Ibovespa sobe aos 205 mil pontos com 'trade eleitoral'; dólar cai para o nível abaixo de R$ 5
itens.descricao: Tempo real: Ibovespa sobe aos 205 mil pontos com 'trade eleitoral'; dólar cai para o nível abaixo de R$ 5 Money Times
itens.texto:
O coordenador da campanha de reeleição do presidente da República, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), Camilo Santana, confirmou nesta sexta-feira (23) que governo vai encaminhar projeto de lei que propõe o perdão de dívidas ativas com a União de empresário do setor de eventos, restaurantes e bares enquadradas no Simples Nacional. Montante de débitos é de R$ 15 bilhões e medida pode atingir até 400 mil empreendedores.
“Vamos encaminhar projeto de lei que possa perdoar a dívida ativa com União de todo o setor de eventos, inclusive muitos do Simples Nacional, donos de restaurantes, de bares. Essa dívida chega a R$ 15 bilhões, são quase 400 mil empreendimentos”, disse Camilo Santana, que se encontrou com o presidente da Câmara dos Deputados, Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), mais cedo para discutir essa proposta.
